remarks: Welcome to this fully renovated single-family ranch-style home 3/4 bedrooms, perfectly situated near everything Stamford has to offer! This bright and spacious home features an open-concept layout with 3 bedrooms and a full bathroom on the main level - ideal for comfortable living and effortless entertaining. The fully finished basement adds incredible versatility, offering a spacious family/playroom, full bathroom and a extra room ideal for home office or guess bedroom - perfect for working from home or hosting guests. Conveniently located with easy access to the Merritt Parkway, and just 45 minutes from New York, this home combines suburban charm with commuter-friendly convenience. Prospective tenants must have excellent credit and be able to verify all income. A credit check and complete rental application will be required. Pets will be considered.
